requirements: R1: Clear or retry the 5 failed tasks currently blocking the Flow Core

slices.title: Clear failed tasks to unblock Flow Core
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to clear or retry the 5 failed tasks, so that the Flow Core is no longer blocked by the failed frontier
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the project is halted in BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER
When the system clears the failed tasks
Then the tasks are reset and the Flow Core resumes work
And a test ensures tasks are cleared successfully
slices.tocConstraintRef: Flow Core blocked by unhandled failed tasks
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce active BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER incidents from 1 to 0

requirements: R1: Revert the status of task 0bcb9d29 which is incorrectly marked as 'done' despite PR#53 being closed without merge

slices.title: Patch task 0bcb9d29 status to reflect unmerged PR
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status fix for this epic, I want to correct the status of task 0bcb9d29, so that it accurately reflects that PR#53 was closed without merge
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given task 0bcb9d29 is marked as 'done' with an unmerged PR
When the status patch process runs
Then the task status is reverted to an open or failed state
And a test verifies status correctness
slices.tocConstraintRef: Task status desync causing false completion reporting
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' task statuses from 1 to 0
